title: Budgeted shadow proxy with differential sampling and tenant-level crediting
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Implement a non-intrusive shadowing proxy that duplicates live requests to candidate model lanes with per-tenant budget enforcement, differential sampling rates and safe failover. The proxy should support dynamic sampling policies, credit-based tenant isolation, adaptive backpressure when the shadow path is saturated, and hooks for automated rollback on quality or cost regressions.
background: We need a system to run continuous shadow traffic against new model versions without exceeding tenant budgets or introducing latency regressions. Existing mirrors either duplicate everything (costly) or sample uniformly (miss rare edge cases). This ticket designs a credit-aware proxy that variably samples by tenant and route, logs metrics for canary evaluation, and integrates with rollouts and rollback automation.
design_summary: - Sidecar/proxy intercepts request and duplicates to configured shadow targets asynchronously. - Differential sampling: sampling rate decided by tenant credits, route importance, and recent failure/error signals. - Per-tenant credit ledger enforces monthly/daily budgets and can scale down sampling to zero when depleted. - Adaptive backpressure: if shadow queue latency or error rates rise, degrade sampling and mark targets as unhealthy. - Cost accounting events emitted to billing and observability (token estimates, model variant, request hash). - Integrates with rollout controller to link shadow traffic to canary/A-B experiments and auto-rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Proxy can duplicate requests to one or more shadow targets asynchronously with <1ms added median latency to primary path
Per-tenant credits are consumed on duplicate sends and honor tenant caps; when credits exhausted sampling reduces to zero
Differential sampling policy supports route-level overrides and recent-error-based dampening
Shadow path saturation triggers circuit that reduces/removes sampling and emits alert
All duplicated requests are annotated and logged with stable request_id, sample_reason and cost_estimate
Rollout controller can use shadow metrics to automatically recommend rollback when quality delta exceed thresholds
tasks: proto: sidecar shim + async duplication loop
implement credit ledger and rate limiter per tenant
sampling policy DSL and policy evaluator service
observability: request-level tags, cost events, dashboard + alerts
integration tests with canary controller and rollback handler
load test to verify cost gating and backpressure
risks_and_mitigation: Cost overrun if per-request cost estimate inaccurate — mitigate by conservative estimates and early shutdown on unexpected spend spike
Data exposure risk for sensitive inputs — sanitize payloads before duplication or honor tenant opt-out flags
Latency regression risk — always perform duplication asynchronously and enforce strict timeouts
Skewed sampling could miss regressions — allow targeted high-sampling routes for critical customers
